start_rule: the ticker key starts with the date and a four-digit clock time: the scheduled start S, read as US Eastern time. Checked once per family, not per match: the share of development matches whose market closed 4 to 240 minutes after S is printed; under 80% the family is 'start not derivable' and no result of it is read.

families.contracts: two an event; every match format

constants.fee: 0.07 x price x (1 - price), rounded up to the next cent

amendments: Amendment 3 (Nov 12): families are ESPORTS and TABLE_TENNIS only, 2 tries; the registration file's dated amendments override this file where they differ
